title: nageia cumingii
intro: Nageia cumingii, commonly known as the Philippine redwood, is a species of coniferous tree native to the Philippines. This tree is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help in treating conditions like fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory diseases. The therapeutic actions of Nageia cumingii include its antiseptic, antimicrobial, and anti-tumor properties, making it a potential treatment for infections and certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of Nageia cumingii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
